newsitem.title: BRAZIL: German Allianz raises stake in Brazil firm.
newsitem.headline: German Allianz raises stake in Brazil firm.

text.p: Germany's insurance group Allianz AG has invested $21.5 million to increase its voting stake to 48.5 percent in Brazilian industrial insurance firm Allianz-Ultramar, Allianz-Ultramar said in a statement.
Allianz-Ultramar, a joint-venture between the German group and Brazilian insurance firm Bradesco, said it will change its name to Allianz-Bradesco Seguros S/A.
The firm also said Allianz group would hire German underwriters and engineers to reinforce its team in Brazil to meet growing demand from domestic and Mercosur clients.
The new team is expected to be completed by 1997, and bring advanced risk management and prevention practices.
"We are hiring international specialists. No other Brazilian firm will be so prepared in industrial risk," Carlos Motta, Allianz-Bradesco vice-president, told Reuters.
Motta said the economic growth that comes along with the ongoing Real stabilization Plan coupled with the privatization of state companies made Brazil a promising country for industrial risk.
Among Allianz-Bradesco major clients are pharmaceutical, auto and white-goods firms, Motta said.
